test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

**__Specify__** the issue of feminism in your own words.
solution: The correct answer is **"define."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Specify"** means to say or name something clearly or in detail. (स्‍पष्‍टता या विस्‍तार से कुछ कहना या किसी का उल्‍लेख करना) • **Example**: *The fire regulations **specify**__ the maximum number of people allowed in.* • The synonym of **"specify"** is **"define."** • **"Define"** means to state or explain the meaning of something clearly and precisely. (किसी बात का अर्थ स्पष्ट और सटीक रूप से बताना या समझाना) __ • **Example**: *We will **define**__ the rules afterwards.* • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Brief"** means short or concise. (संक्षिप्‍त या अल्‍पकालिक) • **"Refute" **means to prove something wrong or false. ((कथन, सिद्धांत, तर्क आदि) ग़लत साबित करना, खंडन करना) • **"Criticise" **means to express disapproval or judgement. (किसी की निंदा या आलोचना करना) 43:T63b, The correct answer is **"A short nap."**
